en.title: Five aviation incidents in one roundup: Singapore A350 smoke diversion, Frontier A321 cabin flood and more
en.summary: A roundup of five aviation incidents from November 10-11: a Singapore Airlines A350-900 diverted to Rockhampton with smoke in the cabin, a Frontier Airlines A321 diverted to Chicago after a lavatory leak flooded the cabin, plus a cargo 737 windshield failure, an An-124 dropping a part on departure and a Cathay Pacific 777 returning after a bird strike.
body: A Singapore Airlines Airbus A350-900, registration 9V-SHA, performing flight SQ-236 from Brisbane to Singapore, was en route at FL360 about 100nm west of Rockhampton when the crew decided to divert to Rockhampton reporting smoke in the cabin. The aircraft landed safely on Rockhampton's runway 33 about 20 minutes later. Passengers reported they observed smoke in the cabin and the screens in the cabin went blank. The airline reported it is investigating the cause of the smoke. A replacement A350-900, registration 9V-SHJ, positioned from Brisbane to Rockhampton, resumed the flight and is estimated to deliver the passengers to Singapore with a delay of about 9 hours. The occurrence aircraft was still on the ground in Rockhampton about 11 hours after landing.

A Frontier Airlines Airbus A321-200N, registration N688FR, performing flight F9-3566 from Denver to Detroit, was en route at FL330 about 150nm west of Chicago when the crew decided to divert to Chicago after a leak in the forward lavatory caused water to flood the cabin and run down the aisle. The aircraft landed on O'Hare (ORD)'s runway 10C about 25 minutes later. The airline reported the forward lavatory "sprung a leak" and caused water to flow along the aircraft floor. A replacement A321-200N, registration N655FR, reached Detroit with a delay of about 4.5 hours.

A Serve Air Cargo Boeing 737-800, registration 9S-ANA, performing flight SVC-41 from Kinshasa to Kindu, was en route at FL350 when the left hand windshield cracked. The crew descended the aircraft to FL270 and continued to Kindu for a safe landing about 1:50 hours after departure. DR Congo's BPEA reported the windshield cracked and subsequently shattered. The BPEA is looking into the occurrence.

An Antonov Design Bureau Antonov AN-124-100, registration UR-82007, performing freight flight ADB-357F from Nagoya to Angeles, was climbing out of Nagoya's runway 36 when the aircraft dropped some part onto the runway. The aircraft continued the flight to Angeles for a safe landing on runway 02 about 4:50 hours later. Nagoya's runway was closed for about 50 minutes for inspection.

A Cathay Pacific Boeing 777-300, registration B-KPD, performing flight CX-252 from London Heathrow (LHR) to Hong Kong, departed Heathrow's runway 09R but received a bird strike into the right hand engine (GE90). The crew initially continued the flight, climbed to FL310 and was about to enter Czech Airspace near Nuremberg when the crew decided to return to Heathrow due to right hand engine vibrations. The aircraft maintained FL310 on the way back and landed safely on Heathrow's runway 09L about 3 hours after departure. A passenger reported the aircraft was just rotating for takeoff when a loud bang occurred and a large streak of flame was emitted by the right hand engine. The nose came briefly down again before the aircraft rotated up again and climbed out. The captain later announced they had experienced a bird strike. ACARS messages from the aircraft suggest the right hand engine experienced higher than normal vibrations and a higher than normal EGT but was still normal. The captain intended to continue the flight and make a final decision when about to enter Turkey unless otherwise advised by operations. The flight was cancelled.

zh.title: 五起航空事件彙整：新航A350客艙冒煙轉降、邊疆航空A321客艙進水
zh.summary: 11月10日至11日五起航空事件彙整：新加坡航空A350-900客艙冒煙轉降洛克漢普頓、邊疆航空A321前庁所漏水導致客艙進水轉降芝加哥，另有貨機擋風玻璃破裂、安-124起飛掉落零件與國泰睿鳥擊折返。
body: 新加坡航空一架空中巴士A350-900（註冊編號9V-SHA）執飛SQ-236航班由布里斯本前往新加坡，11月11日在FL360高度、洛克漢普頓以西約100海里處，機組回報客艙冒煙並決定轉降洛克漢普頓，約20分鐘安全降落在33號跑道。乘客表示客艙內可見煙霧，客艙螢幕全部變黑；航空公司表示正在調查冒煙原因。一架替代A350-900（註冊編號9V-SHJ）由布里斯本調往洛克漢普頓接手航班，預計旅客延誤約9小時抵達新加坡；事發飛機在降落約11小時後仍停留在洛克漢普頓。
邊疆航空一架空中巴士A321-200N（註冊編號N688FR）執飛F9-3566航班由丹佛前往底特律，11月11日在FL330高度、芝加哥以西約150海里處，因前方庁所漏水導致客艙進水、水沿走道流動，機組決定轉降芝加哥，約25分鐘降落在歐海爾機場10C跑道。航空公司表示前方庁所漏水導致水沿機艙地板流動；替代A321-200N（註冊編號N655FR）以約4.5小時延誤將旅客送抵底特律。
Serve Air Cargo一架波音737-800（註冊編號9S-ANA）執飛SVC-41航班由金夏沙前往金杜，11月10日在FL350高度左側擋風玻璃出現裂縫，機組下降至FL270並繼續飛往金杜，起飛約1小時50分鐘安全降落。剛果民主共和國的BPEA表示擋風玻璃出現裂縫、隨後碎裂，正在調查這起事件。
安托諾夫設計局一架安-124-100（註冊編號UR-82007）執飛ADB-357F貨運航班由名古屋前往安吉利斯，11月10日自名古屋36號跑道爬升時有零件掉落跑道，飛機繼續飛往安吉利斯，約4小時50分鐘安全降落在02號跑道；名古屋跑道關閉約50分鐘進行檢查。

國泰航空一架波音777-300（註冊編號B-KPD）執飛CX-252航班由倫敦希斯洛（LHR）前往香港，11月10日自09R跑道起飛後右側發動機（GE90）遭到鳥擊。機組起初繼續飛行，爬升至FL310，接近捷克空域、紐倫伯附近時因右側發動機震動決定折返希斯洛，回程維持FL310，起飛約3小時後安全降落在09L跑道。乘客表示飛機剛離地時傳出巨響，右側發動機噴出大片火焰，機頭曾短暫下沉後再度拉起爬升；機長隨後廣播說明遭遇鳥擊。ACARS訊息顯示右側發動機震動與排氣溫度高於正常，但仍在正常範圍；機長原打算繼續飛行、接近土耳其時再做最後決定，除非營運部門另有指示。該航班隨後取消。
